bound.scope: Preflight only: freeze exact acquisition identity, integrity expectations, byte budgets, network surface, gating status, retention/cleanup, and cost ceiling for the eight T022-admitted candidates. No weight bodies are fetched, no execution occurs, no runtime/quantizer winner is selected.
do_not: execute any model, quantizer, runtime, Colab session, or Unsloth install
accept gated terms or authenticate to any model provider
select a canonical runtime or final quantizer (T029/T030 own that)
start T028 without separate explicit founder authorization

candidates.revision_verified_at: 2026-08-26T04:00:00Z (live metadata HTTPS GET during T027 preflight)
candidates.weight_format: bf16 safetensors (sharded per model.safetensors.index.json where present)
candidates.post_download_sha256_verification_requir: Every downloaded weight file MUST hash-match its declared LFS OID SHA-256 from expected_file_integrity before admission to T028 verification; mismatch quarantines the file and fails that candidate closed.
candidates.artifact_manifest_verification_method: T028 emits an mstr.artifact.v1 manifest (ArtifactFileEntry: relative_path+sha256+size) verified offline via mstr_qualify.artifacts.verify_artifact against the acquired external directory.
candidates.T024_verifier_compatibility: COMPATIBLE — T024 verify_artifact accepts exact per-file SHA-256 + size identity; expected_file_integrity supplies the upstream side of that comparison.
candidates.rights_decision_evidence: Apache-2.0 confirmed live at pinned revision: HF tag 'license:apache-2.0', README front matter, and verbatim LICENSE file present in tree.
candidates.retention_policy: Acquired artifacts persist in the external acquisition directory until T034 local-artifact admission closes; candidates rejected at T034 are retained only if referenced by open review evidence, else deleted.
candidates.cleanup_policy: Any partial or integrity-failed download is deleted immediately; successful artifacts are never mutated in place (re-acquire instead).
candidates.cache_policy: No shared provider cache is populated; direct-to-final-path streaming keeps peak storage equal to final storage.
candidates.artifact_location_policy: All binaries live outside Git under artifacts/external/<candidate_id>/ (gitignored); manifests and evidence stay inside Git.
candidates.git_exclusion_policy: artifacts/external/, models/, downloads/, *.safetensors, *.gguf, *.pt, *.pth, *.onnx are already covered by .gitignore; T028 must not weaken these rules.
candidates.cost_ceiling: USD 0.00 — any payment requirement aborts toward T028 with PAID_ACCESS_REQUIRES_NEW_FOUNDER_DECISION.
candidates.expected_download_storage_aggregate: 4,571,203,846 bytes download / 4,571,203,846 bytes final on disk (~4.26 GiB); optional files add 776 bytes
candidates.failure_behavior: A failed or integrity-mismatched download halts only that candidate, deletes partials, records EXCLUDED_ARTIFACT_UNRESOLVED in T028 output; other candidates proceed. No substitute revision is ever fetched silently.

unauthorized_categories: arbitrary web browsing beyond the allowlist
git protocol endpoints (no git-lfs clone; HTTPS range GETs only)

cost.expected_storage_cost: local disk only; peak 45.40 GiB across all eight candidates
cost.policy: EXPECTED_ACQUISITION_COST = 0. Any artifact requiring payment stops with PAID_ACCESS_REQUIRES_NEW_FOUNDER_DECISION. No paid Colab, no rented GPU, no inference API.

retention_cleanup.retention_policy: Artifacts persist in the external acquisition directory through T028-T034 qualification; after T034 closes, candidates absent from its admission decision are deletable on founder approval.
retention_cleanup.cleanup_policy: Partial downloads are deleted on first failure; verified artifacts are immutable (re-download rather than patch); cleanup actions are logged in evidence.
retention_cleanup.cache_policy: No provider cache population; direct-to-final streaming keeps peak storage equal to final storage.
retention_cleanup.artifact_location_policy: Binaries under gitignored artifacts/external/<candidate_id>/; only manifests, hashes, and evidence enter Git.
retention_cleanup.git_exclusion_summary: .gitignore already blocks models/, weights/, downloads/, data/raw/, artifacts/external/, artifacts/tmp/, *.safetensors, *.gguf, *.pt, *.pth, *.onnx.

git_exclusion.verification: T028 must run `git status --ignored` after acquisition and assert zero untracked weight files; a violation fails T028 closed.

proposed_t028_authority_envelope.stays_blocked_until: Separate explicit founder authorization naming manifest id T027-weight-access-preflight-frozen and the approved candidate subset.
explicitly_required_for: HTTPS GET of exactly the required_artifact_files listed per approved candidate
what_T028_does: stream-download pinned artifacts over the declared host allowlist
record acquisition outcome per candidate (acquired / EXCLUDED_*)
what_T028_does_not: run any model, quantizer, runtime, or training step
install Unsloth or open Colab sessions
fetch revisions not listed in this manifest
grant backbone, finalist, or local_qualified status (T034/T050/T055)
proposed_t028_authority_envelope.post_T028_does_not_automatically_open: Completing T028 opens nothing beyond recording acquisition evidence; T029 quantization profile work remains separate with its own scope.

unresolved_risks: Ministral-3-3B, Granite-4.1-3B, SmolLM3-3B lack a standalone LICENSE text file at their pinned revisions; rights rest on consistent machine-readable tag plus explicit README declarations at the same revision. Mitigation: preserve each README as the notice artifact and re-check before any redistribution.

Aggregate download/final footprint ~45.4 GiB exceeds single-laptop comfort for some machines; the founder may approve a bounded subset at T028 time — this manifest permits subset selection without editing candidate entries.
Qwen3.5 family ships vision-encoder weights inside the same shards; text-only serving validation is deferred to runtime qualification (T030), not resolved here.
CDN redirect targets are documented from current observation but may evolve upstream; T028 must pin observed redirect hosts in its own evidence before downloading.
